issues.reason: Dropping the passive 'hold' makes the top-level (Theme sk_tell_1 ...) record a false report — that he said he wants everyone to BE responsible (i.e. actually culpable) rather than to be HELD responsible by someone.

*Categorical statements* bars exactly this — 'a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule' — and 'everyone' is an explicit universal.
Same rule: the reified involved state holds of each involved person, so (Experiencer sk_involved_1 sk_group_1) makes the group-as-object the state's holder, the reading the plural rules warn against.

gaps_confirmed: object-predicative complements of judgment verbs ('hold / consider / deem X responsible', and the agentless passive 'be held responsible') — no section covers a secondary predicate that ascribes a state rather than causing it

a universal quantifier inside a sealed complement ('wants everyone involved ... to be ...') — a seal takes one atom or an (And ...), with no way to place the required Implication distribution rule inside one
new_gaps: whether the RESTRICTOR of a quantified NP introduced inside a seal ('everyone involved in his son's death') projects out of the seal — the projection rule speaks only of a definite NP's typing atom
the QuantifierPhrase companion has no correct predicate slot when the quantified predication is sealed and only the restrictor is expressible at top level
repair_summary: Replaced the four top-level involved-state atoms with one distribution rule over the group's members, (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_involved $x) involved) (Experiencer (sk_involved $x) $x) (In (sk_involved $x) sk_death_1) (Member $x involved))) at (STV 1.0 0.9), removing both group-as-object predications; reinstated the dropped passive by reifying the hold event inside the seal — (Theme sk_want_1 sk_hold_1) (Member sk_hold_1 hold) with the responsible state sealed under (Theme sk_hold_1 ...), the agentless-passive shape of *Impersonal reported attitudes*, so responsibility is ascribed rather than predicated.
notes: The QuantifierPhrase companion was deliberately omitted: the quantified predication is the sealed wanting, so a companion naming person/involved would misrecord which predication 'everyone' governs. The group filler inside the seal was kept, as no rule form is available inside a seal.
